summary: A7 (AI Catalog Enrichment + Bulk Actions) verified end-to-end. BACKEND: 10/10 pytest tests pass (TestAuth, TestSummaryAndFilters, TestEnrichmentJob with overwrite=false skip + overwrite=true regenerate, TestBulkActions). The async job pattern via POST /api/admin/products/enrich-bulk + polling GET /api/admin/jobs/{job_id} works correctly: enrich of 2 products completes in ~10s, descriptions become bilingual (EN+KA, each >=30 chars), name_ka populated. Idempotency holds (overwrite=false: skipped_already_enriched == len(ids), 0 LLM calls). Overwrite=true regenerates content. /products/summary.needs_enrichment EXACTLY matches GET /admin/products?needs_enrichment=true count (187). status=draft / status=published / brand= filters all match summary counts. Bulk publish/unpublish/delete round-trip succeeds (matched, modified, deleted reported correctly). FRONTEND: /admin/login → /admin redirect works. /admin/products renders with admin-products-page testid, products-counts shows '355 total · 355 published · 0 drafts · 182 need AI', all 4 tabs present, tab-needs filters to 50 visible rows, brand-filter populated, row-checkbox toggle reveals bulk-action-bar with selection-count, clear-selection hides it, bulk-enrich-button triggers JobProgressCard which polls and within ~3s shows 'AI enrichment complete · ok 1 · skip 0 · err 0', and the needs_enrichment header count visibly decreases (187→182 — confirmed in screenshot). All 7 bulk buttons (select-all-checkbox, select-all-in-view, clear-selection, bulk-enrich-button, bulk-publish-button, bulk-unpublish-button, bulk-delete-button) and ka-status badges are present and wired.

issues: React hydration warning logged to console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The dev tooling overlay injects an x-excluded <span> inside each <option> in the brand-filter (AdminProducts.jsx L355 — brandOptions map). It is a dev-only warning and does NOT prevent the dropdown from working, but should be silenced before production. Quick fix: render brand option label as a plain string, not via an instrumented span (or wrap the map in a Fragment so the dev overlay does not splice a span into option).

action_items: (LOW) Silence the React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' in AdminProducts brand-filter — it's only a dev-tooling artifact but pollutes the console.

(INFO) Catalogue currently has 0 drafts and 355 published rows; 187/355 published rows still need_enrichment (missing name_ka/description_ka or short EN description). The 'Drafts' tab shows 0 and is correctly empty. If the operator wants to test enrichment from the Drafts tab specifically, they would need to bulk-unpublish a few rows first (the UI supports this — verified).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/admin_routes.py now 1123 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Split per-resource (auth/products/offers/plans/blog/jobs/uploads) before A8.

services/job_store.py is clean and reusable — good. ENRICH job stores per-item failures and progress in MongoDB so polling survives a browser-tab close. Note: jobs in 'running' state are NOT resilient across backend restarts (acknowledged in module docstring). For long catalogue sweeps the UI should display a 'last_updated_at' staleness warning if updated_at is >60s old in running state.

services/llm_enrichment.needs_enrichment uses the same EN-length>=30 + name_ka + description_ka heuristic as the summary count Mongo expression — confirmed they agree exactly (187 == 187) over the live catalogue.

admin_routes._run_enrich_job uses asyncio.Semaphore(3) which is appropriate for LLM-key budget but means a 187-row 'enrich all' will take ~5-10 min wall time. UI polling at 2s is fine but the header counts only refresh after the whole job ends; consider streaming the needs_enrichment count down as each item completes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: A7 is fully working both API and UI. The /enrich-bulk → /jobs/{id} async pattern is solid. Idempotency, overwrite, and bulk publish/unpublish/delete all verified. Catalogue has 0 drafts (all 355 are published); 182 of them still need_enrichment after this run. test_enrich_bulk_iter14.py picks needs_enrichment products regardless of status (because there are no drafts). If a future iteration adds drafts back, narrow the selector to status='draft' to keep behavior closer to the original review request. Only outstanding cosmetic issue is the React '<span> in <option>' hydration warning in the brand-filter.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA — all listed acceptance criteria pass. The single console warning is a dev-tooling artifact (the overlay injects x-excluded spans for component tracking, which React rejects inside <option> elements). It is not a functional defect.
